name: HOT ROCKET 5x 3x 2x

features.name: Rocket overlays
features.description: Rockets overlay symbols and may trigger Jackpot Spins.

features.name: Random multipliers
features.description: 2x, 3x and 5x multipliers land on set reels.

review:
A retro stepper-style game on nine lines, set in a jungle under a volcano – it feels like a land-based machine.

Rockets land on any reel and sit over symbols; collecting one can trigger Jackpot Spins, with the symbols underneath still in play. Random 2x, 3x and 5x multipliers land on set reels, and there are five jackpots. Medium-low volatility, 2,500x max and 96.1% RTP. Nostalgic and easy-going.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
